rule_results.name: Transaction velocity burst
rule_results.description: Fires when an account records 5 or more transactions within any 10-minute window.
rule_results.explanation: Densest window held 1 transactions, below the 5-transaction threshold.

rule_results.name: Amount spike vs account baseline
rule_results.description: Fires when a transaction in the last 7 days exceeds 5.0x the account's median transaction amount (baseline drawn from the preceding 90 days, excluding the most recent 7).
rule_results.skipped_reason: Only 0 settled transactions available in the baseline window; 10 required. No baseline means no verdict - this is NOT evidence that the account is clean.

rule_results.name: New geography with high value
rule_results.description: Fires on a transaction of 1000 USD or more, in the last 14 days, in a country the account had not transacted in during the preceding 180 days.
rule_results.skipped_reason: No transaction history in the comparison window, so every country looks 'new'. Evaluating would produce a meaningless result.

rule_results.name: Structuring below reporting threshold
rule_results.description: Fires when 3 or more transactions, each between 8500 and 10000 USD, occur within any 72-hour window - the classic signature of splitting a payment to stay under a reporting threshold.
rule_results.explanation: At most 0 sub-threshold transaction(s) clustered within 72 hours, below the 3 required.

rule_results.name: Device shared across multiple accounts
rule_results.description: Fires when a device used by this account in the last 30 days was also used by 3 or more distinct accounts in that window - the signature of a credential-stuffing or account-takeover operation driving many victims from one machine.
rule_results.skipped_reason: No device login events recorded for this account in the last 30 days. Device telemetry may simply not be wired up for this account - absence of events is not evidence of a clean device.

rule_results.name: Impossible travel between card-present uses
rule_results.description: Fires when two card-present transactions in different countries occur within 120 minutes of each other in the last 30 days - a physical impossibility implying a cloned card.
rule_results.skipped_reason: Fewer than two card-present transactions in the evaluation window; the rule needs a pair to compare.

interpretation_contract.authority: This engine is the sole authority on WHICH rules fired. It is deterministic: identical inputs always produce identical verdicts. Do not re-derive, override, soften, or supplement these verdicts with your own judgement about the raw transactions.
interpretation_contract.your_role: Explain what the fired rules mean for this account and recommend an action. Cite rule_id and the evidence_txn_ids for every claim you make.
interpretation_contract.skipped_is_not_clean: 4 rule(s) could not be evaluated. A SKIPPED rule is an unknown, not a pass. Report skipped rules explicitly rather than treating them as absence of risk.

provenance.note: All timestamps are evaluated against 'as_of', a frozen dataset clock, not wall-clock now. Quote 'as_of' in any written finding so the result can be reproduced.
